name: @educateos/control-plane
description: The optional educateos.io control plane (SCHO-206, ADR-0013): operator sign-in through Cloudflare Access, the operator and installation store (a SQLite Durable Object), and the /app routes the educateos.io site Worker (sites/educateos-io) serves beside its static pages. A library with no wrangler.jsonc, so release discovery never treats it as part of a district release.
